items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That thing, and the other side too, “The Comeback.” Foster wrote that. Everybody stole from that. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.
